Which algorithms the bundled library has and their sizes, its version, and the known-answer test that shows it computes them correctly.

Each section is one help page: what its functions are for, and the example
of the page as it runs. `?name` gives the arguments and the value in full.

## Algorithms and their sizes

`nqalgs()`: Lists every signature and key encapsulation algorithm the bundled library provides, with the sizes in bytes of its keys, signatures, ciphertexts and shared secrets.

```{r nqalgs}
a <- nqalgs()
a[a$type == "sig", c("name", "pk", "sk", "sig")]
a[a$type == "kem", c("name", "pk", "sk", "ct", "ss")]
```

## Version of the bundled noqtis library

`nqver()`: The version of the noqtis C library compiled into this package, which is also the package's own version.

```{r nqver}
nqver()
utils::packageVersion("noqtis") == nqver()
```

## Known-answer self-test of the bundled noqtis library

`nqselftest()`: Runs fixed inputs through every algorithm family and compares the outputs with stored answers, the power-on self-test a FIPS 140-3 cryptographic module runs before it is used.

```{r nqselftest}
nqselftest()
system.time(nqselftest())
```
